findings: OrchestrationReasoning has the required public machine fresh-load boundary proof for a test-owned deterministic fixture using the LEARN-04 pattern id/schema.

PromptToTask and SkillSelection are accepted only as narrow public adaptive-loader evidence because their test-owned deterministic fixtures are adaptive overlay checkpoints, not full machine checkpoint plus manifest artifacts.

Accepted is derived from exact track verdicts, all loads, the successful test-only OrchestrationReasoning Plan selection, no runtime invocation claim, no semantic/common mutation, path redaction, and verified temp fixture deletion.
No semantic quality, held-out/source-disjoint, ablation, rollback, promotion, common-model mutation, runtime, external AI, or real promoted-target claim is made.

tracks.limitation: Narrow public adaptive loader only. The test-owned deterministic fixture is an adaptive overlay checkpoint without a PromptToTaskMachine manifest, so this does not prove PromptToTaskMachine.LoadCheckpointAsync or Translate.

Fresh-load proves loadability and public machine invocation for the test-owned deterministic fixture only. It does not prove semantic quality, held-out/source-disjoint behavior, ablation, rollback, or promotion readiness.

Narrow public correction-adaptive loader only. The test-owned deterministic fixture is not a full SkillSelectionMachine checkpoint/manifest, so this does not prove SkillSelectionMachine.LoadCheckpointAsync or DecideFromTrainedState.
